summary: Complete testing of NEW features for VISUWORKS website. Tested scroll restoration (ScrollToTop.jsx), /api/contact backend endpoint with validation/honeypot/rate-limiting, contact form UI, and /danke thank-you page. 13/14 backend tests passed (1 hit rate limit which is expected behavior). All frontend tests passed.

Scroll restoration: Navigate from /prozess/analyse (scrolled to 1428px) to /kontakt - page starts at top (0)
Backend /api/contact POST: returns success with valid data (name, email, message) - status 200
Backend /api/contact POST: accepts all optional fields (phone, service) - status 200
Backend /api/contact POST: rejects empty name - status 422 with validation error
Backend /api/contact POST: rejects empty email - status 422 with validation error
Backend /api/contact POST: rejects invalid email format - status 422
Backend /api/contact POST: rejects empty message - status 422 with validation error
Backend /api/contact honeypot: silently accepts when 'website' field has value (returns success but doesn't send email)
Backend /api/contact honeypot: empty honeypot processes normally
Backend /api/contact: all 5 service options accepted (mobilitaet, architektur, kommunikation, design, projektmanagement)
Backend /api/ health endpoint returns 200
Backend rate limiting: 5 requests per 5 minutes per IP working (429 status after limit)
Contact form UI: form exists with all fields (name, email, phone, service dropdown, message)

Thank-you page (/danke): renders with 'Vielen Dank!' heading, confirmation message
/danke page buttons: 'Zur Startseite' button navigates to /
/danke page buttons: 'Projekte ansehen' button navigates to /projekte

context_for_next_testing_agent: All NEW features tested and working: 1) ScrollToTop.jsx correctly resets scroll to position 0 on every route change using useLocation/useEffect, 2) /api/contact endpoint works with Pydantic validation (EmailStr, min_length), honeypot field (alias='website'), rate limiting (5 req/5min), 3) Contact form (KontaktPage.jsx) has data-testid attributes, hidden honeypot field, client-side validation via ContactService.validate(), 4) DankePage.jsx renders thank-you content with navigation buttons.
